# MVP Definition for "Home of Exile" Application

## First Version Scope
- Backend exists
- Frontend exists
- User can paste a Path of Building Export Code into a text area
- Application parses the Export Code and extracts basic character information (class, level, equipment, main skill)

## Second Version Scope
- Application provides recommendations to improve character power:
  - Suggest support gems to enhance main skill
  - Recognize non suitable equipment (i.e. when main skill is a spell and equipment has attack modifiers and vice versa)
